name: Northwest Pipeline Colorado Hub Connection

values.OtherEnglishNames: NWPL Colorado Hub Connection Project; CHC
values.EndLocation: White River Hub, near Meeker Gas Processing Plant, Piceance Creek

researcher_notes: Not an existing row: the roster holds Northwest Gas Pipeline P0230 as the system plus named expansion rows (Kalama Lateral, Kelso-Beaver, Wild Trail), none for this lateral. Completed 2009 lateral of 27.4 miles (about 44 km), which is over the 25 km new-pipe threshold. Row shaped as an expansion row under the parent name. The 2009 EIA table (Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 627, FERC docket CP08-477) lists 27.4 miles, 24 inches, cost 60.4 million dollars, completed 10 November 2009, status Completed. The Federal Register notice of 29 April 2008 gives about 27.5 miles of 24 inch lateral from the Northwest Pipeline system at Douglas Creek south of Rangely to the planned White River Hub and the Meeker plant, Rio Blanco County. An NS Energy news item from April 2009 reports FERC approval of 27.4 miles. Capacity left blank on purpose: EIA states 582 MMcf per day but the news item states about 360,000 Dth per day, and the two do not agree. Owner spelled as the Federal Register spells it; the current legal form may be Northwest Pipeline LLC and was not checked. Parent not staged because no checked source names it. No route found, so route left as no route; check FERC filings for alignment maps. Tier high: three sources, EIA and the notice are separate origins.
